news.og_title: Intuit Q1 FY2027 Earnings: Online Growth and Cost Discipline Lift Profit
news.og_desc: Intuit’s Q1 FY2027 revenue rose 12% to $4.354 billion, while GAAP diluted EPS increased 63% to $2.59 and GAAP operating income climbed 63% to $868 million. Online Ecosystem revenue grew 20%, led by 19% growth in QuickBooks Online Accounting and 21% growth in Online Services, while Mailchimp revenue fell 1%. Intuit also agreed to sell Mailchimp for approximately $3.68 billion, updated FY2027 revenue guidance, and reiterated full-year operating income and EPS guidance. The guidance excludes any impact from the pending divestiture.

news.title: Gold Edges up from 14-month Low as Markets Assess Fed Rate Outlook
news.og_title: Gold Edges up from 14-month Low as Markets Assess Fed Rate Outlook
news.og_desc: Gold prices ticked up on Thursday, after hitting a more-than-one-year low earlier in the session amid growing US interest rate hike bets, while investors looked to Federal Reserve commentary for fresh signals on monetary policy. Spot gold rose 0.3% to $3,733.76 per ounce by 0630 GMT, after hitting its lowest level since September 2025 at $3,693.13 per ounce earlier in the session. US gold futures for December delivery fell 0.1% to $3,737.20.
